channel.title: Records Research Group
channel.description: Public-records accessibility research — Oregon administrative and financial records. Findings, derived datasets, and the request/response record itself, free at the point of access (CC0).

item.title: Findings published: eight documented patterns from a 163-request sweep
item.description: Eight findings pairing stated records obligations with observed desk behavior: transparency-dead-zone deflection, desk-level and narrowing-immune fee treatment, email-channel refusals, 53 unacknowledged requests, 18 filed petitions with lapsed order clocks, and a custodianship vacuum for a fatal low-head dam. Each carries witnesses in the scoreboard and explicit non-claims.

item.title: Scoreboard regenerated: 163 requests across 130 bodies
item.description: The request ledger now covers the full Oct-Nov sweep: 19 productions, 9 fee estimates totaling $4,851.61 ($0 paid), 23 waiver requests (2 granted, 5 denied), 53 unacknowledged requests, and 18 petitions for review (L1-L18). Per-row anchors for citation.

item.title: Five new request pages: ESS contracts, millrace, Eugene register
item.description: 26-1032 (ESS contract file, free, no rate schedules possessed), 26-1055 (procurement file), 26-1083 (Exhibit C revision history - resolved), PRR-2026-926 (73,464-row register emailed free), PRR-2026-948 (city dam records, in flight). Four existing pages extended with petition and production events.

item.title: Lane County jail medical contract #57233 (Wellpath LLC): $34.1M cumulative authority through FY2027
item.description: Document ladder of all eight executed instruments on Lane County's Wellpath jail-medical contract: cumulative authority $34,123,588.24 through FY2027, annual run-rate +42% since FY23, one-bid procurement history, and an open census question — the vendor's own staffing matrix assumes 300 ADP while the contract's escalation trigger sits at 350.

item.title: Lane County homelessness-response spending, CY2023–2025: $47.0M
item.description: Rollup of Lane County voucher-register payments to homelessness-response and housing-assistance program lines, CY2023–2025: $46,955,415 across 15 program lines and 5,745 payments. Aggregate dataset published under data/.

item.title: Lane County study update: two fee waivers denied; $1,284.59 quoted across four estimates
item.description: Lane County denied fee waivers on requests #26-971 and #26-974, citing the requester's "plan and ability to distribute the information." Invoices: $186.48 (payroll), $728.89 (voter-roll statistics). City of Eugene issued a $277.20 estimate (PRR-2026-896). Waiver record: 0 granted, 2 denied, 2 pending.

item.title: Public-records accessibility scoreboard published
item.description: Per-request ledger for the October 2026 request wave: 21 requests, 6 agencies — filed/acknowledged/produced, fees quoted vs paid, waiver outcomes. CSV available under data/.

item.title: Per-request permanent pages live
item.description: Stable URLs for each portal-ticketed request: scope, correspondence timeline, fee calculations, current status.

item.title: Lane County records accessibility study — research note posted
item.description: A systematic set of Oregon Public Records Law requests to Lane County and Oregon state agencies, measuring how much routine administrative and financial information is visible to the public — and what it costs to get what isn't.
